proven_pattern: Keep distributable CSS/JS in catalog/view/theme/default/template/extension/<module>/ so OC3 theme fallback uses one physical copy.
Build public URLs from that fixed default-theme path under DIR_APPLICATION.

On the product injection, render fragment-local <link> and <script> beside the widget rather than relying solely on Document::addStyle/addScript, because Journal can rebuild/cache the header before an OCMOD-injected product widget is evaluated.
jet_weaknesses_not_copied: Unguarded filemtime() that warns if the file is missing
Business logic inside the OCMOD XML
oc3_requirement: Guard filemtime so missing files do not emit warnings; keep injected OCMOD code minimal and delegate to module-owned logic.
